stemMd: When was an absence of visible water described as normal?

options.label: A
options.textMd: When the channel had been permanently disconnected

options.label: B
options.textMd: After every storm regardless of upstream conditions

options.label: C
options.textMd: Only when the basin had been removed

options.label: E
options.textMd: Only during construction before the park opened

explanationMd: The channel carried rainwater intermittently, so dry-weather emptiness was expected. The same appearance after rain could have a different significance and warranted inspection.

distractorRationale.b: After rain, absence could indicate a blockage.
distractorRationale.c: The basin remained part of the system.
